'''Kemends''' was an individual who worked within the same company where [[Justahl]] served as [[Vice President/Legends|Vice President]]. Kemends was not a particularly well liked person, but was in line to receive Justahl's share options if the Vice President did not arrive at a meeting on time.<ref name="GFT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kemends was first appeared in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''.
